Create a new notification rule.

The ``scope_id`` must be a GUID, never a name (Requirement 9.6).
The rule name is generated from scope and trigger, qualified with the
project (Requirement 9.7).

Validates every field per Requirement 10 before persisting.  Returns 422
with clear error messages on failure (Requirement 10.1).

When the rule's scope names a project, workflow, or node, the handler
enforces project access because the middleware cannot know the project
from the request body alone (Requirement 11.4).

The file is committed to the instance repo on write.
